The Devil Wears Prada is one of my favorite movies of all time and is arguably one of the most formative movies for a whole generation of fashion lovers. However, not everything you see on the silver screen is true to life. Was the Devil Wears Prada ACTUALLY on trend or was it actually a fashion failure? Find out in today’s episode!
